description: Java class implementing a tenant service that manages tenant data stored in a file, with in-memory caching, loading on startup, and periodic saving on shutdown.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantService
classes.description: A Vert.x component managing tenants stored in a file with in-memory cache, supporting CRUD operations, loading on startup, and periodic persistence.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, loads tenant data from file if configured, and sets up periodic saving.

methods.name: loadTenantData
methods.description: Loads tenant data from the configured file into memory.

methods.name: checkFileExists
methods.description: Checks if the tenant file exists, optionally creating it if missing.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Parses tenant data from JSON buffer and adds tenants to in-memory store.

methods.name: addTenant
methods.description: Adds a tenant from a JSON object to the in-memory store.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Persists tenant data to file and stops the service.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves current tenants to the configured file if dirty flag is set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information by tenant ID.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads tenant data with optional version check.

methods.name: getTenantResult
methods.description: Returns operation result for tenant fetch by ID.

methods.name: getTenantObjectResult
methods.description: Returns tenant data as JSON object for external use.

methods.name: getForCertificateAuthority
methods.description: Finds tenant associated with a given certificate authority DN.

methods.name: removeTenant
methods.description: Removes a tenant by ID, considering resource version.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new tenant with optional ID, ensuring no conflicts.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates tenant data, checking for conflicts and version.

methods.name: convertTenant
methods.description: Converts Tenant object to JSON, optionally filtering authorities.

methods.name: getByCa
methods.description: Finds tenant entry by certificate authority DN.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Returns cache control directive based on configuration.

methods.name: checkResourceVersion
methods.description: Checks if actual resource version matches expected.

methods.name: generateTenantId
methods.description: Generates a unique random tenant ID.
